evidence.excerpt: To fill this gap, we present a Chinese Human-AI Collaborative Text Detection Benchmark (C-HAT-Bench), a unified benchmark that links $5,000$ human-written source texts from five domains to more than $240,000$ variants produced using six generative models under Prefix-Conditioned Continuation as a reference setting and three collaborative production modes.
